usedFor: Loyverse holds sales, shifts and customers from the till, and Calendly makes booking links through “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Receipt Created” in Loyverse, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A sale is a good moment to prepare a booking link for the buyer's next visit.

watchOut: “New Receipt Created” in Loyverse is polling, so the link is made after a scheduled check.
